result.summary: Vardhit Auto Components has one open overdue of INR 7.0M, now 36 days past due (vs. prior resolved cases that cleared within 3-6 days of due date). This is a sharp jump from the historically prompt payment pattern, though notification frequency itself has eased slightly (2 vs 3 in prior 6-month windows) and all exposure remains with a single insurer (TCI) well within its INR 60M limit.
concerns: Current overdue (36 DPD) is far longer than any prior resolved overdue (max 6 days late), signaling a material change in payment behavior
All exposure concentrated under a single policy/insurer (TCI-WT-2026-0002), limiting cross-validation of buyer's broader payment conduct
No resolution date yet for the open notification, so true days-late could climb further
